about: #33 row 3 screenshot schedule (M3). Times are seconds after A3D = the first 3D frame = the first slow-frame line with 'new >= 15' more than 60 s after FF (FF = the first slow-frame line). Picked from moments.txt (offsf/onsf/offd/ond/stop5): the drop clusters sit at the same A3D offsets within +-1.3 s in all five runs, while A3D itself moves by 16 s against FF (FF+82 in onsf/ond, FF+98..101 in offsf/offd/stop5). burst = capture continuously at up to max_fps; still = 3 captures 0.3 s apart (persistence check).
